transaction.title: SYNTHETIC — bank to exchange to wallet to cash-out
transaction.narrative: SYNTHETIC walkthrough: USD 40,000 from savings was sent to an exchange, used to buy 1 BTC, withdrawn to a wallet, returned to the exchange and sold for USD 50,000. This fictional example demonstrates manual links across different assets and dates; it does not establish authenticity or ownership.
